name: Dice Whisperer
body:
Your ears are so sharp, and so attuned to the fall of the dice, that you can tell, sight unseen, what numbers are showing on their faces.

Prerequisite: Blind, 6 ranks in Perception, Incorrigible Gambler.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to Perception checks. Furthermore, if you succeed on a DC 20 Perception check, you can tell what numbers are showing on any dice you have heard land. When playing gambling games which require you to guess the face of dice, you may add your Perception skill when making a Profession (gambling) check.
